cases.prompt:
Is this page ready for launch from an SEO point of view? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html Home

Welcome

Our services

```
criteria: Flags noindex as a launch blocker
Flags the generic 'Home' title and missing meta description
Mentions Open Graph / social preview tags

cases.prompt: We use Google Analytics and a Meta pixel on our EU client's site, loaded on every page immediately. Our footer says '100% GDPR compliant'. Anything to fix? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says analytics and marketing pixels must wait for consent
Says the consent banner must allow rejecting as easily as accepting
Flags '100% GDPR compliant' as an unsupported claim
Recommends a privacy/cookie policy listing the third parties
Recommends human legal review rather than definitive legal advice

cases.prompt: Our site claims to be available in English and Spanish, but the checkout shows `checkout.submit_button` on the Spanish version and dates look like 09/30/2026 for Spanish users. Is it OK to announce multilingual support? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says raw translation keys visible to users are a blocker
Says the multilingual claim should wait until fixed
Recommends checking for hardcoded strings and fallbacks
